rejections.reason: Why are you using exact shape I drew? My drawing was super rough, i expected you to take that as a guide not exactly.

patterns: A hand-drawn sketch is a GUIDE, never a template. User's words on r2-10: "My drawing was super rough, i expected you to take that as a guide not exactly." Redraw the IDEA as a properly constructed letterform; never reuse the traced path geometry.

Smoothing a sketch means RECONSTRUCTING it — proper curves, deliberate stroke logic, real letterform proportions. Averaging the wobble out of their line and keeping that outline is not smoothing, it is tracing.
Never reuse one outline across a batch. All 10 of round 2 shared the same traced S and all 10 were rejected. If every candidate contains an identical path, the batch has already failed.

ARROWHEADS MUST BE BUILT TO MATCH THE STROKE THEY END — proportional width, same cap language. Oversized flat triangles bolted onto a round-capped stroke read as broken. r1-27 was rejected with "Looks messed up." and is built exactly that way: `<path d="M 78.00 33.00 L 65.00 20.00 L 91.00 20.00 Z"/>` triangles on a `stroke-linecap="butt"` stroke.
Do not mix cap styles inside one mark. `stroke-linecap="butt"` (hard square ends) beside round-capped or rounded-rect elements is a large part of why r1-27 reads unfinished.

AFFECTED SIBLINGS, not yet judged: 20 further round-1 symbols carry the identical loose-triangle + butt-cap construction — r1-03, r1-21, r1-22, r1-23, r1-24, r1-25, r1-26, r1-28, r1-29, r1-30, r1-31, r1-32, r1-33, r1-34, r1-35, r1-36, r1-37, r1-38, r1-39, r1-40. Expect the same reaction; rebuild rather than fan out from them untouched.
A fan-out is 10 interpretations of the source's IDEA: 2 close, 4 reinterpreted, 4 bold departures. Never a parameter sweep, never one drawing at N values of X.
Card notes must name the IDEA explored, not the number changed.
The mark must survive at 24px with the letter still readable.

DROPPED AS UNSUPPORTED: earlier rules about solid vs outlined containers, value contrast, and stacked-vs-single squares were inferred from the first 7 round-2 rejections. The remaining 3 were then rejected too, so that theory has no surviving evidence and was removed rather than kept as noise.

CONFIDENCE NOTE: of 12 rejections, only 3 carry words — "too busy" (r2-01), the r2-10 sentence in rule 1, and "Looks messed up." (r1-27). Those are solid; the rest here is inference and should be corrected if wrong. QUARANTINED — NOT A DESIGN SIGNAL: r4-04e1e1 was rejected "Duplicate". It is a visual duplicate of r4-04e1 (measured: 35 of 115600 pixels differ, 0.03%, inside one 41x33 patch). That is housekeeping of an accidental re-save. Do NOT infer any design rule from it, and do NOT treat the r4-04 ring-and-arrows direction as rejected — r4-04e1 itself still stands in candidates.
